question: Why does the paper conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, given how much lithium it leaches?
expect: False premise: the paper concludes aqueous processing IS compatible with NMC 811 (p5.L80-81); only ~3 wt% Li leached after one week (p5.L62-63); retention ~70% vs ~76% for NMP
rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. Instead, it discusses the challenges associated with aqueous processing of NMC 811, such as lithium leaching, but also presents results showing that aqueous-processed NMC 811 cells can still demonstrate very good electrochemical performance. The paper suggests that these issues could be solved with further optimization of the formulation and mixing protocols used for aqueous processing and modifications to the formation protocol.
